item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
Issued at 09:30 AM 28 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Sorsogon(Pilar, Donsol, Castilla), #Albay(PioDuran, Guinobatan, Jovellar, Tiwi, Oas, CityOfLigao), #CamarinesNorte(Paracale, Vinzons, Talisay, Daet, Mercedes, Basud, SanLorenzoRuiz, SanVicente, JosePanganiban), #CamarinesSur(DelGallego, Buhi, IrigaCity, Baao, Bula), #Masbate(Monreal, SanPascual and Claveria) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Albay(LegazpiCity, Daraga, Camalig), #Sorsogon(Magallanes, Matnog, SantaMagdalena, Juban, Bulan, Casiguran, Bulusan, Irosin), #Catanduanes(Caramoran, SanAndres), #CamarinesSur(Caramoan, Presentacion, Garchitorena, Lagonoy, Goa, Tinambac, Calabanga, Bombon, Magarao, Libmanan, Canaman, Gainza, Camaligan, NagaCity, SanJose, Tigaon, Ocampo, Pili, Milaor, Minalabac, SanFernando, Pamplona, Pasacao, Cabusao, Siruma, Ragay, Lupi, Sipocot, Sagñay), #OrientalMindoro(Bansud, Bongabong, Mansalay, Roxas), #Romblon(Banton, Corcuera, Concepcion), #Marinduque(Torrijos, Buenavista and SantaCruz) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
